title: Routing fixes, fewer turns & close-up map update
features: Eliminated unnecessary U-turn spurs: two-way streets now pick the right direction at start and destination, and bounded cleanup bypasses remaining turn-restricted spurs and sharp reversals without breaking needed U-turns.

Simpler routes with fewer turns: tight multi-turn side-street zigzags are replaced with straighter legal main roads when added travel time stays small (within 20%, capped at 30 s per leg) while keeping true driving-time ETA.

Fixed close-up road snap after parking off-road: at Z6–Z9, pulling into a car park or driveway and stopping now smoothly eases the map and vehicle arrow back to GPS. Software-only update — 100% compatible with existing maps.
Close-up road alignment at Z6–Z9 (2.2.6.1): display-only road matching keeps the vehicle marker and route start cleanly centred on roads using existing Z6 geometry.

Unguided local ML learning: Preferred Nearby POIs, Usual Parking (including habitual car parks with no saved places nearby), POI-named stops/predictions and Usual Route shortcuts learn without an active route.

Unguided commute alerts & predictions: Likely traffic, Frequent slowdown and Cold-weather slowdown cues warn without a route (with dynamic hazard decay/expiry), alongside weekday/weekend weighting and aligned Adaptive Auto-zoom.

Live expandable GPS HUD inside the top clock pill (HH:MM:SS seconds, Day/Night compass dial, accuracy, satellites, altitude and coordinates), adapting cleanly to popups and menus — toggled by double-OK or console REPEAT.
Expanded Auto zoom and manual driving zoom across Z9–Z4 with speed hysteresis, close-up Z7–Z9 street names and tighter View diversion / View route Explore framing.
